metadata.question: Is the nighttime light intensity higher in Grindavík compared to Reykjavík on November 21, 2024?

data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
grindavik = ee.Geometry.Point([-22.4333, 63.8425])  # Grindavík, Iceland
reykjavik = ee.Geometry.Point([-21.8278, 64.1353])  # Reykjavík, Iceland
date = '2024-11-21'

# 2. Data Acquisition - VIIRS Nighttime Lights Daily (VNP46A2)
collection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A2') \
    .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) \
    .filterBounds(ee.Geometry.Point([-22, 64]))  # Filter to Iceland region

# Check if collection is empty
if collection.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print(f"No VIIRS nighttime lights data for {date}.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Get the first (should be only) image
    image = collection.first()
    
    # Select the DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL band
    ntl_band = 'DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL'
    
    # 3. Check for valid pixels at both locations
    # Get pixel counts (non-null values)
    grindavik_count = image.select(ntl_band).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=grindavik,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get(ntl_band).getInfo()
    
    reykjavik_count = image.select(ntl_band).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=reykjavik,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get(ntl_band).getInfo()
    
    print(f"Grindavík valid pixels: {grindavik_count}")
    print(f"Reykjavík valid pixels: {reykjavik_count}")
    
    # Check if either location has no valid pixels
    if grindavik_count == 0 or reykjavik_count == 0:
        print("No valid nighttime light pixels at one or both locations.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # 4. Calculate mean nighttime light intensity
        grindavik_value = image.select(ntl_band).reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=grindavik,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get(ntl_band).getInfo()
        
        reykjavik_value = image.select(ntl_band).reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=reykjavik,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get(ntl_band).getInfo()
        
        print(f"Grindavík NTL: {grindavik_value:.2f} nW/cm²/sr")
        print(f"Reykjavík NTL: {reykjavik_value:.2f} nW/cm²/sr")
        
        # 5. Validation & Final Answer
        # Check for invalid values (None, NaN, or unrealistic values)
        if (grindavik_value is None or reykjavik_value is None or 
            grindavik_value != grindavik_value or reykjavik_value != reykjavik_value or  # Check for NaN
            grindavik_value < 0 or reykjavik_value < 0 or  # Negative radiance is invalid
            grindavik_value > 1000 or reykjavik_value > 1000):  # Unrealistically high
            print(f"Invalid NTL values detected.")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            # Compare values
            if grindavik_value > reykjavik_value:
                print("Grindavík has higher nighttime light intensity.")
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("Reykjavík has higher or equal nighttime light intensity.")
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
